prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a birthday lawn with several guests each holding an equal small bunch of blue balloons. There are EXACTLY 6 people and EACH person holds EXACTLY 3 blue balloons -- the same number each -- so the TOTAL number of blue balloons is 6 x 3 = EXACTLY 18. Not 17, not 19; every person holds exactly 3. The blue balloons are well separated and individually visible. No text, no numerals.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show several people each holding the SAME number of balloons, so the total number of balloons is the number of people times the number each one holds? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q: How many blue balloons are in this image? Several people each hold the same number; count the TOTAL number of blue balloons across everyone. Count them one by one. Answer with the integer number only.
reference.q_notext: Does this image have any printed number, digit, numeral, written label or caption overlaid on it (as opposed to being purely a photograph / drawing of the scene with no text)? Answer yes if you can see ANY printed number or word, no if there is none. Answer yes or no only.
reference.d2_q_objform: This picture should show these countable objects: several people each holding the SAME number of balloons, so the total number of balloons is the number of people times the number each one holds. Look at the individual objects being counted. Is each one a blue balloon, and not some other object, a shapeless blob, or a mixture of different things? Answer with the single word yes or no only.
reference.d2_q_occlusion: Look at the objects being counted in this image. Is EVERY one of them visible as its own separate individual (allowing for the intended overlaps/stacking the scene describes), rather than merged into one indistinct blob? Answer yes if each intended object can be told apart, no if they merge into an uncountable mass. Answer with the single word yes or no only.

steps.read_crop: Look at the middle of this picture. Can you see something {gt.target_color} there? Answer no if the thing you can see is a different colour, or if there is nothing here but background, a hand or a string. Answer yes or no only.

steps.ask: Does this image show several people, each holding a similar small bunch of the same kind of item? Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: one balloon held on its string by one of the guests on the birthday lawn

steps.read_crop: Does this cut-out show ONE whole blue balloon, rather than a balloon of some other colour, a ball or other round object, a shapeless blob, or only part of a balloon? Answer yes or no only.
